why: At b12600 llama.cpp's Metal backend does not support multiplying NVFP4 weights, and this file keeps the checkpoint's NVFP4 experts, so those multiplications fall back to the CPU. With offload of all layers requested and llama.cpp's default of 2 CPU threads, llama-bench gave pp512 28.6 and tg128 15.5 tok/s, against 319.2 and 33.6 for the IQ3_XXS build; the two files also differ in other ways. In an agent check, the 30-minute limit ended before the agent got a reply. Not scored, by the maintainer's decision.

result: not tried: builds of about 20 GB
why: Its library's only builds are the original checkpoint, about 20 GB in NVFP4 and MXFP8, with its drafter. We expected too little headroom on a 24 GB Mac, as the model's card asks for 32 GB or more, and did not load it. Support needs 0.40.17, a pre-release on 2026-11-21.

We found no lmstudio-community build, and its installed runtimes predate support: its llama.cpp runtime (2.73.0) predates llama.cpp's Inkling 2 Mini support (b12600, 2026-11-20), and its MLX runtime relies on mlx-lm, whose support is a draft pull request. We checked the catalog on Hugging Face and the installed runtimes; no load was attempted.

why: Inkling 2 Mini support is a draft pull request (ml-explore/mlx-lm#2086), not reviewed on 2026-11-21, and the release we have (0.32.2) has none. mlx-community's 4-bit build is made with that branch and was not tried.
Inkling 2 is not mentioned in its releases, issues or pull requests on 2026-11-21. No load was attempted.

version: 2.13.1, an addendum on 2026-11-22 (at round 3's runs on 11-21, 2.12.3 had no Inkling support)
why: MTPLX 2.13 added Inkling 2 Mini the day after round 3, with Bare Speed as its listed pack for 24 GB. In one check at its default memory and context settings, it loaded the pack, planned its own 24,576-token window, and returned two bash calls that ran: requests 1 and 15 of the attempt's 45, retries included. Its memory guard declined 42 of the others before prefill and stopped one during prefill ('the other apps on this Mac leave 2.0 GiB free, and this prompt needs about 0.2 GiB more than that'), and the task check failed. Other applications were open: 7.4 GB of anonymous pages at launch. The maintainer stopped after this check, with no scored suite and MTPLX's settings unchanged. Details: mtplx-check.md.

Inkling 2 Mini's looped architecture would need a new implementation in raceline, which is in maintenance mode: a cache per pass, 128-expert MoE, and window and global attention with relative positions.
